messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi Timothy
I have a quick job. Like to see if you’re free.

•	I have a paperback cover that needs 2 small fixes (delete a few words of my blurb + matching the title font across front/spine/back). No redesign, files are final otherwise. 
•	Output needed: .psd (layered), .pdf, .jpg 
•	Needed within 24 hours 
•	Are you available?

My budget is $30.

Best,
Caryn

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hi Caryn,

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay, yes 

I'm available

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Let's move on with the project, Caryn

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: This is the paperback book cover I worked on recently.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi Timothy, thanks for the speedy reply.

Two small fixes needed, not a redesign
Blurb swap: trimmed last paragraph, currently overlaps the barcode — just needs dropping in and reflowing
Title font inconsistent: front cover uses bold gold-gradient font, spine/back use a plainer one — need all matched to front
I'll send images, templates, and the .psd
Need .psd (layered), .pdf, .jpg back within 24 hours — does that work?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes, it works Caryn

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Great. Will invite you to the job and upload the info. Thx! Best, Caryn

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alright, thank you for the opportunity, Caryn.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I will be expecting the editable files

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
I'm including book 1 (The Emperor's Curse) to allow you to compare fonts currently on book 2's spine and back cover. I'd like the fonts to be uniform. Please let me know if you have any questions.
Best,
Caryn

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The.psd didn't go through. Will upload it now.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay, I will go through them now.

I will let you know if I have any questions.

But to confirm, your book is 300 page counts right?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: yes. It's 300 pages. FYI - I publish on Amazon (which the print book is 300 pages). But on Draft2Digital - they use Ingram (for print distribution) which added 2 pages to my book. I don't know if that affects the spine. So I am shortening my blurb since there's nothing I can do to stop D2D from making my page count 302 instead of 300. The issue is the bar code.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: You can see D2D's template has a spine of 0.68 inches but Amazon's is 0.75 inches.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay, I understand both Amazon and Ingramspark.

For the 2 pages addition for Ingram, we can create for both 300&302 pages.

And yes, both platforms may not have the same specs.

So to be saved, we'll need to create for each platform. It's better this way.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Excellent idea.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Alright, Caryn.

I will update you in some hours time.

I was about to leave my work desk when I received your message.

The project is well understood now.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: excellent. Thanks. Is the price still agreed?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Ohhh 

We're yet to discuss that.

You can add $20 for the Ingramspark since, we'll be working on both Amazon and Ingramspark now.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Kindly let me know your feedback on that, Caryn

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Of course. Right now I'm asking D2D if there's a bug. At 300–302 pages on Cream paper, the spine should be approximately 0.75", matching my Amazon file exactly — but D2D keeps generating 0.68", even after I followed their instructions to resave Step 2 and re-download the template fresh. I definitely want you do fix the blurb and font. Start on that. Will update you soon regard spine.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay.

We can start with Amazon.

We're good to go with that.

I have not encountered the 2 pages addition on Ingram before.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Its rather a shock. :)

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Let's stick with 300 pages / 0.75" spine. I need to hear from D2D before I change the spine. thanks!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
This is a screenshot 

The changes have been made.

The title spine font and back font matches with the title at the front now.

The spine width has been applied too and overall, it meets Amazon requirements.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: What's the update on the second one so I can deliver all the files.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I will confirm this from my end.

It's possible that D2D have criteria different from Amazon.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Looks good. Is it possible to download it and test it on D2D's platform?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: No news from D2D yet. Still waiting. It's very frustrating.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Yes sure.

I will send you the PDF file so you can test.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: thanks

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
This is it.

It's 223MB.

I will be expecting the results on D2D

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi Timothy,

I'll post on D2D's social media. maybe that will get a faster response.

However, there's a problem with your cover.

• The blurb edit and title font look good, both fixed correctly.
• One problem: the tagline at the top of the front cover ("A CHINESE HOLIDAY MURDER MYSTERY") is showing as garbled, corrupted text instead of the actual words.
• This looks like a font substitution or encoding issue — please check what font that text box is using.
• When you re-export, make sure the fonts are embedded or outlined/converted to curves so the text doesn't depend on font availability and renders correctly everywhere.
• Please fix and re-send .pdf first

Thx
C-

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay 

I will check now

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
It's fixed now.

Sorry for the earlier error

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Got it. Its launch day. Gotta do social media. Will get back to you later today. Thkx. Hopefully by then I'll hear from D2D.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alright, that's great.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I can't believe I still haven't heard from D2D. Let's hold off on this until tomorrow. I'll order something (which may or may not be the right specs for the cover). I will give them one more day. Thanks for your patience. Best, Caryn

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay, Caryn.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hi Tim, It doesn't seem to be fixed yet. Please redo and check yourself.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I will try again

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Ohh maybe I sent the previous file.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I will send you the correct file.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Ok. Maybe old/cached file by mistake, retesting now
\- D2D update: still need 2 covers (Amazon + Ingram), but D2D's spine (0.68") doesn't match Ingram's own formula (should be 0.755") — unresolved, may take 48-72 hrs
\- Hold off building anything to 0.68" until I confirm the right number
\- Will follow up shortly.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay.

Just to confirm. Are you working with Amazon, Ingramspark and D2D? Three platforms right?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Your book will be on the three platforms right?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: No. AMazon and D2D. D2D uses Ingram's network for print.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hi Tim — quick update: I don't have an Ingram account to verify this myself, so I've asked D2D directly what paper-thickness factor they're using, since it looks like Ingram's cream stock may just genuinely run thinner than Amazon's, which could explain the spine difference. (Unfortunately - D2D is slow in replying). I will check with some author FB groups to see if anyone knows. Very frustrating. Can we keep this job open another day or two? thanks! The upside is I know now to have 2 covers made. Didn't have this problem with book 1 :). In the meantime can you confirm the page count, font etc you used in the updated cover? Thx

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: No problem, Caryn.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I will resend the cover for Amazon soon and we'll be done with that.

It will remain D2D only.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: This is a screenshot from my end after I downloaded the last sent file.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I just tried to upload your latest file to Amazon. Don't know what the error is. There's no reason. Just what it says.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: My AI says this: Font embedding. We already found one issue in this project where a font wasn't properly embedded/outlined, causing garbled text in a different viewer. It's possible the fonts in this file aren't fully embedded, and KDP's processor is stricter about that than the tool I used to preview it.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Here's the PDF Font details. It says all fonts are embedded

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Well hmmm. I'm stuck then.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The file seems to be too large for Amazon to process. I'll send you a new exported pdf file

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Ok. Amazon does allow for 650 MB but a bloated file can sometimes make uploads more prone to timing out or failing mid-transfer, Go ahead and send the smaller file. thx.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I've optimized the PDF file size for a smoother upload. The print quality remain unchanged.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I was able to upload the bigger file at last. Will keep the smaller file on hand as a back up.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay.

That's good.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: So, we're left with D2D.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: yep

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
HI Timothy,
Go ahead and do the D2D cover at the D2D template spine width 0.68 inches. I'll modify the job to add $20. No word from D2D. However I can't believe there's a bug in their template - otherwise many authors would complain. Thanks,
Best,
Caryn

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Here's the D2D template.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay, Caryn

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Optimized version

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Upload this on D2D and give me feedback.

The two files are the same.

One has a lower file size.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thanks will test it now

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Can you give me the final product in PDF, .PSD and .JPG?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Can you send me the PDFs again? Apologies. I don't know now which is for amazon (300 pages) and the one for D2D (302 pages). thkx

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Yes sure

Should I add the PDFs with the deliveries again?

Since I have sent them already.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: yes please

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hi Timothy, I'm ready to end the contract. D2D has another issue. They add Amazon on their print set up page. I can't tell if they'll distribute to Amazon (which would duplicate my listing and double my commission - plus get me in trouble with Amazon). Anyhow I'll have to wait for their reply. So I still can't hit publish on D2D. But that's my issue not yours. Please send over files

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay no problem 

I'm working on the files to send as ZIP.

You can approve the first $30 since the Amazon own is sorted.

We'll be left with only D2D.
